name: Mubite

programs.name: One-Step Pro
programs.notes: Funded payout needs 3 profitable days (>=0.5% each) per cycle and Funded Score <30%. Fee not refundable.

programs.name: One-Step Lite
programs.notes: Funded payout needs 5 profitable days per cycle and Funded Score <20%. Fee not refundable.

programs.name: Two-Step Pro
programs.notes: Evaluation needs 3 profitable days in phase 1 and 2 in phase 2. Funded Score <40%. Entry fee refunded with first payout (not on BOGO purchases).

programs.name: Nitro (Pay After You Pass)
programs.notes: $19.90 entry fee, then a one-time activation fee (10K $81, 25K $211, 50K $390, 100K $641) payable within 5 days of passing. Total list cost 10K $100.90, 25K $230.90, 50K $409.90, 100K $660.90. First payout 14 days after first trade; 5 profitable days per cycle; Funded Score <20%. Discount codes not allowed.
programs.fee_note: Entry fee only: an activation / funded-account fee is charged after you pass

programs.name: Instant Pro
programs.max_drawdown: 10% Smart Drawdown (locks at 5% below equity once +5% reached)
programs.notes: No daily drawdown. First payout after 14 days from first trade and +5% profit. Funded Score <25%. Max single position 1x and total exposure 2x initial balance.

programs.name: Instant Lite
programs.drawdown_type: static (per pricing data; FAQ Smart Drawdown text covers Instant Funding generally)
programs.notes: 7 profitable days per payout cycle; Funded Score <15%. First payout after 14 days from first trade and +5% profit.

profit_split_scale: 80% standard on One-Step/Two-Step/Nitro, 90% with paid Increased Profit Split add-on; Instant Funding 70%, 80% with add-on
payout_frequency: First payout on demand once funded (One-Step/Two-Step), then every 14 days; Instant Funding and Nitro first payout 14 days after first trade. Per-payout caps 2.5% → 5% of starting balance for payouts 1–6, uncapped from payout 7.
consistency_rule: Funded stage only: Funded Score (best day / total profit from profitable days in cycle) must be below 30% One-Step Pro, 20% One-Step Lite/Nitro, 40% Two-Step Pro, 25% Instant Pro, 15% Instant Lite before each payout; plus required profitable days (>=0.5% of start balance) per payout cycle. Never breaches the account.

notes: List prices taken from the structured program data on /challenge-prices (rendered price before discount). Halloween promo on 2026-10-31: 15% off regular products and up to 50% off the two new products (One-Step Lite, Instant Lite); e.g. $100K One-Step Pro $819 → $697. fee_from = $49 (One-Step Lite $5K); Nitro starts at $19.90 but needs an activation fee after passing (total from $100.90). Prices shown here differ from the price ranges in the FAQ text ('$45–$1,199', 'from $79', 'Instant $112.50–$4,999'), which look out of date. Same goes for min trading days: Rules page and pricing data say no minimum, but older FAQ answers say 10/3 days. Daily drawdown for One-Step is 3% on the rules page (one FAQ says 4%). Assets: USDT perpetuals only, including tokenized gold (XAUT) and tokenized stocks/commodities on Cleo; no forex. Free 7-day $100K trial available. Risk rules: 3% max realized loss per trade, funded position limits 2x single / 3x cumulative (Instant 1x/2x). Founded year is not on its own site. Legal entity Mubite s.r.o. (ICO 23221551). Trustpilot: the page shows 'rating unavailable due to a breach of our guidelines' and 'We've removed a number of fake reviews' (59 reviews, 73% 5-star, 21% 1-star). It also has one detailed public dispute over a $9,000 payout denial and account closure (company replied), so trustpilot is left null. Flag for review.
